thread:
auditor_jane: Hi team — SOC2 auditor here. We need a consolidated evidence package for the March 14 API incident that impacted auth token validation and billing events. Specifically: timeline of detection/mitigation, alert screenshots, support tickets, audit log exports showing KMS/HSM key ops for the time window, KMS key metadata (key id/arn, key rotation state), HSM attestation or audit journal, and proof of retention policy application for those logs. Please confirm owner and ETA.

sasha_security: assigning this to maya_soc2 and ops. Can you confirm the exact time window you want? March 14 03:20–04:10 UTC?

auditor_jane: yes that window is perfect. We want original audit log entries (not just summary) for that window, and any cross-linked artifacts (support ticket IDs, incident timeline doc). We also need the exported logs to be integrity-checked (hash or signature) and the storage location.

ben_support: putting together the support ticket thread ids now. Ticket IDs: SUP-3421, SUP-3423. Noted repro steps we recorded. Quick repro curl we used: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/auth/verify -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'X-Request-Id: repro-20240314' -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
# expected 200, saw 500 with auth:invalid header
```

nate_oncall: ops can export CloudTrail and KMS logs. For HSM we have an audit journal extractor — will pull HSM journal entries for that window. Planning to export to s3://redwood-audit/soc2/2024-03-14/incident-exports/ and include SHA256 sums in manifest. 

liam_sre: note that there are also internal tracer spans and gateway logs that correlate to latency spikes. I can include request-id -> trace mapping for the sample ids. Those are in the tracing bucket: s3://redwood-traces/prod/2024/03/14/.

sasha_security: legal_anna — can we hand raw logs to auditors or must we redact customer PII first?

anna_legal: please redact or mask any customer PII before external transfer. For internal SOC2 reviewer access we can provide full exports within our secure workspace, but public auditor downloads must be redacted. Provide a checklist of fields to mask and mark as "sensitive" in the manifest.

maya_soc2: taking ownership. ETA: initial package (redacted export + manifest + hash) by EOD +2 (two business days). Full internal package with signed HSM journal and original keys metadata to internal auditor workspace by EOD +3. I'll post S3 presigned links and a short timeline doc.

auditor_jane: can you also map controls (which control IDs this evidence addresses) and provide the chain: alert -> ticket -> mitigation -> postmortem? That helps auditor mapping.

maya_soc2: yes. We'll include control mapping (CC6.1/6.2 equivalents), list of artifacts per control, and a one-page timeline with timestamps and owners.

nate_oncall: exporting KMS usage: key arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345. Will include decrypt/GenerateDataKey operations for the window. HSM journal will be signed with HSM key thumbprint and included.

ben_support: attaching quick notes from support: "03:26 UTC - first auth 500s spike observed; 03:33 - rollback token cache change; 03:45 - error rate <1%". Will include ticket links and short repro steps.

liam_sre: re: latency complaints — will add latency dashboard screenshots and per-route breakdown. Will include the grafana snapshots and the alerting rule ids.

anna_legal: reminder: redact emails/phone numbers, obfuscate customer IDs, but keep request-ids and trace ids intact for correlation.

maya_soc2: goals confirmed. Deliverables: 1) redacted audit export (S3 + manifest + sha256), 2) signed HSM journal, 3) KMS key metadata and usage table, 4) support ticket bundle, 5) timeline + control mapping doc. Owner: maya_soc2. ETA: 48 hours.

auditor_jane: thanks — that timeline works. Please ping when S3 presigned links are ready. :white_check_mark:
